Warranty & Service

At Chronoswiss, we are committed to ensuring the longevity and precision of your timepiece. Our comprehensive warranty and service program reflects this commitment.

International Warranty

Every Chronoswiss timepiece comes with an international warranty of 2 years from the date of purchase. This warranty covers manufacturing defects in materials and workmanship.


The warranty is valid only when:

  • The warranty card is fully completed and stamped by an authorized Chronoswiss retailer
  • The original purchase invoice is presented
  • The watch has not been opened, modified, or repaired by unauthorized persons

What Is Covered

  • Movement defects affecting timekeeping accuracy
  • Manufacturing defects in case, dial, and hands
  • Buckle and clasp defects
  • Water resistance issues (within specified depth)

What Is Not Covered

  • Normal wear and tear (strap, bracelet, glass)
  • Damage resulting from accidents or misuse
  • Water damage beyond rated depth
  • Servicing by unauthorized persons
  • Cosmetic damage not affecting function

Service Intervals

To maintain your Chronoswiss watch in optimal condition, we recommend:


  • Complete service every 4-5 years
  • Annual water resistance check
  • Battery replacement for quartz models (every 1-2 years)

Service Centers

For warranty claims or service inquiries, please contact our authorized service centers:


Email: service@chronoswiss.com

Phone: +41 41 768 88 88

Visit: www.chronoswiss.com/service
